verdicts.file: Synthesis Notes (Loudon) — rich — marble, then the chisel.m4a
verdicts.why: "Everything you hear from there is something taken away" is false by measurement, and Loudon's own notes say why: "resonance is a boost at the cutoff frequency." The honest line only quotes him and owns no choice (the resonance, the sweep, the tanh).
